title: Isometry
extract: In mathematics, an isometry is a distance-preserving transformation between metric spaces, usually assumed to be bijective. The word isometry is derived from the Ancient Greek: ╪╢он©о isos meaning "equal", and н╪ноон©н╫ metron meaning "measure". If the transformation is from a metric space to itself, it is a kind of geometric transformation known as a motion.
